heading_path: 21.22  How fees are to be paid
text: (1) For the purposes of subsection 223(2) of the Act (which deals with payment of fees), a fee, other than a fee payable under Part 13 of the Act, must be paid to the Registrar. Note: See subsection 223(2C), and section 223AA, of the Act for the means of paying a fee to the Registrar. (1A) For the purposes of subsection 223AA(3) of the Act, the Registrar must publish the determination on the IP Australia website. (2) A fee payable under Part 13 of the Act must be paid to the ComptrollerGeneral of Customs. The fee must be paid in accordance with a direction given by the ComptrollerGeneral of Customs as to the way in which it is to be paid.
